==About me==

Thanks for stopping by and checking out my profile. I am never quite certain what to put in these profiles, so I think I will just put what I am interested in when I read the profiles of others. 

I have been reading the Wheel of Time series since 1992 (or 1993, I can never really recall exactly!). I am a big fan of the series, but unlike others, I cannot read it 3, 4, or even 10 times. I have read most of the books at least twice, and probably stopped that around [[Towers of Midnight]]. I am currently listening to the audio books and am really enjoying the narration by Michael Kramer and Kate Reading. 

My favorite scene in the books is the [[Battle_of_Dumai's_Wells]]. In my mind, it's the pivotal point where Rand shows how he can do what must be done.

It is really hard to pick a favorite character from the three Ta'veren, as I like certain qualities of all three, but I usually enjoy Perrin's POV less often  than the other two. 

I have been using this wiki as a reference when I am listening to the books. I often come here to remind myself about some aspect of a character's history when I am stumped. 

I think that my contributions to this edit will primarily be in the guise of correcting spelling and grammar, and I apologize in advance if I step on anyone's toes. I am not interested in changing the writing style of the wiki entries, and will try to talk to someone to make sure my ideas are in line with the community's.
